arguments:
# Use local TTS (bark/tortoise) - write script to a file and produce voice.wav
echo "{{$json.script}}" > /tmp/nova_script.txt
# Replace next line with your TTS CLI call (bark/tortoise/etc)
bark --text_file /tmp/nova_script.txt --out_file /tmp/nova_voice.wav --voice 'NovaFlux' || tortoise-tts --text-file /tmp/nova_script.txt --out /tmp/nova_voice.wav --voice 'NovaFlux'
# Ensure output path exists and copy to staging
mkdir -p /data/staging/audio && cp /tmp/nova_voice.wav /data/staging/audio/{{ $json.meta.id || 'voice' }}.wav || true

# Assemble video using ffmpeg templates
# Input: script, audio at /data/staging/audio/<id>.wav, optional bg video /data/assets/bg_loop.mp4
ID={{ $json.meta.id || 'short' }}
AUDIO=/data/staging/audio/$ID.wav
BG=/data/assets/bg_loop.mp4
OUT=/data/staging/videos/$ID.mp4
mkdir -p /data/staging/videos
# Sample command: overlay SRT captions and loop background to audio length
ffmpeg -y -stream_loop -1 -i $BG -i $AUDIO -filter_complex "[0:v]scale=1080:1920,setsar=1[v];[v][1:a]concat=n=1:v=1:a=1[outv][outa]" -map [outv] -map [outa] -c:v libx264 -c:a aac -shortest $OUT || true
# also create thumbnail
ffmpeg -y -i $OUT -ss 00:00:00 -vframes 1 /data/staging/videos/$ID.thumb.jpg || true
